basis: B26R retrospective topology-realization diagnostic; no B26 outcomes observed
source_family: equal-injection two-center max-union of compact polynomial disk profiles
source_profile_definition: S=A*max((1-r1^2/R^2)_+^2,(1-r2^2/R^2)_+^2), with d/R=delta and R chosen pre-run so integral(S/A)=pi/3
perimeter_rule: sum contour perimeters whose perimeter is at least 10% of the largest contour perimeter at that level

verdict_logic.invalid: any numerical validity gate fails -> IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID
verdict_logic.topology_not_realized: all numerical cases valid but fine topology gate fails -> TOPOLOGY_SPAN_NOT_REALIZED
verdict_logic.pass: all valid + topology gate + all PASS error/stability gates -> AB_TWO_CENTER_FIXED_COEFFICIENT_TRANSFER_PASS
verdict_logic.partial: all valid + topology gate + PARTIAL gates -> AB_TWO_CENTER_FIXED_COEFFICIENT_TRANSFER_PARTIAL
verdict_logic.fail: all valid + topology gate but neither PASS nor PARTIAL -> AB_TWO_CENTER_FIXED_COEFFICIENT_TRANSFER_FAIL

no_fit_rule: The B25.1e sigma_cal is immutable. No B26 target outcome, amplitude, topology, or geometry may modify it.
claim_boundary: A PASS or FAIL applies only to this frozen canonical two-center family and finite resolutions; it is not a universal source/topology theorem.
